# Future Media AG

> Future Media AG is a digital media agency in Zurich, Switzerland, specializing in programmatic advertising, paid social campaigns, and AI-search optimization (GEO) for Swiss small and medium-sized businesses since 2016.

## Facts

- Founded: 2016, Zurich, Switzerland
- Team: 14 media specialists
- Clients: 85+ active Swiss SME clients
- 2025 digital ad spend managed: CHF 4.2 million
- Address: Bahnhofstrasse 100, 8001 Zurich, Switzerland
- Phone: +41 44 555 01 23
- Email: hello@futuremedia-demo.ch
- Languages: German, French, English

## Services

- GEO Audit — CHF 500 one-time: 50-prompt AI visibility test across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude
- GEO Setup — CHF 2,500 one-time: schema stack, answer-first rewrite, FAQ page, GBP, 5 directory submissions
- GEO Management — CHF 800/month: daily monitoring, content refresh, review campaign, monthly report
- Programmatic advertising, paid social (Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok), Google Ads management from CHF 900/month
